Check the current live status of running processes and file outputs in /scratch/gdemil24/Learning-Assisted-InSAR-DEM-Enhancement. Do the following READ-ONLY checks:

1. Run: `ps aux | grep -E "train_film|snaphu|compute_metrics" | grep -v grep` — what processes are running?

Report the EXACT output of each command.
